title: kbmon's sessions panel lists each overlap between live sessions with its announced strategy, and an undecided overlap enters the needs-you line
goal: the sessions panel's data gains overlaps, each pair of live sessions whose intents' items or touches meet as an object with a and b (each the session's label, operator id and item), files (the shared paths) and strategy (undecided, else the strategy a coordinate event between their items announced); the sessions panel's text view lists each overlap with both labels, both items, the shared files and the strategy; an overlap still undecided after announce.needs_you_after_min minutes (kbsettings, read for the clone at --root) is an entry of the needs-you line naming the two items, so it also reaches --status all, the receipt and the mod; an overlap younger than that, or one a coordinate event decided, is no needs-you entry

notes: Premise (run 2026-10-24 on the main branch at 5b032a3f5): both checks fail today: the sessions panel data has no overlaps key and the needs-you line reads 'needs you: nothing' with two live sessions whose intents share a touch. Plan: the earlier single check kept; one check added for the clause the first did not read (an overlap younger than needs_you_after_min, or decided by a coordinate event, is no needs-you entry), and the first now also reads the text view, both labels and operator ids, the shared files and the receipt count. The shape the checks pin: each overlap is an object with a and b (session label, operator, item), files and strategy (undecided or the announced one). Shares mon_needs.py and mon_status.py with the kbmon sprint's ST-czgocppq and ST-n5vf55qk: held --overlaps orders the claims. Waits for ST-wqqpspwl (the coordinate event).
